title: Extract specific fields from command output
summary: Use `cut` with pipes to filter the output of another command. This helps you clean up long command outputs by showing only the relevant columns or characters.

steps.explain: Pipe the output of a command to `cut` to extract specific fields using a delimiter.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command whose output you want to filter

placeholders.name: FIELDS
placeholders.description: Field numbers to extract (e.g., "1-3" for first three fields)

alternatives.explain: Extract specific characters from each line of the command output.
